SourceProxy.label: Gmsh Reader
SourceProxy.name: GmshReader

Documentation.long_help: Read mesh and their data stored in .msh files.

SourceProxy.Documentation: This Gmsh reader reads files stored in the .msh format. The expected file extension is .msh. The output of this reader is a multiblock data set. If physical groups are found, each group result in a block. Else 4 groups are created, 1 for each dimension.

StringVectorProperty.name: FileName
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: This property specifies the file name for the Gmsh reader.

IntVectorProperty.name: CreateGmshCellIDArray
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Specify if we create a cell data array containing Gmsh cell IDs.

IntVectorProperty.name: CreateGmshNodeIDArray
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Specify if we create a point data array containing Gmsh node IDs.

IntVectorProperty.name: CreateGmshEntityIDArray
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Specify if we create a cell data array containing Gmsh entity IDs.

IntVectorProperty.name: CreateGmshDimensionArray
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Specify if we create a field data array containing the dimension for a dataset.

IntVectorProperty.name: CreateGmshPhysicalIDArray
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Specify if we create a cell data array containing physical group tags.

IntVectorProperty.name: GroupByDimension
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Specify if physical groups should be grouped by dimension in a same node in the resulting composite dataset.

SourceProxy.label: Gmsh Meta-File Reader
SourceProxy.name: GmshMetaFileReader

Documentation.long_help: Read partitioned Gmsh solutions described by a .mshi meta-file.

SourceProxy.Documentation: This reader reads the partitioned .msh files that a .mshi meta-file describes, with their time steps. The high-order fields are refined into linear cells up to the adaptation level. Without arrays, only the mesh is read. The output is a partitioned dataset collection with one partition per .msh file.

StringVectorProperty.name: FileName
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: This property specifies the .mshi file name.

StringVectorProperty.name: PointArrayStatus
StringVectorProperty.label: Point Arrays
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: The arrays to read, one per field file of the meta-file. Without arrays, only the mesh is read.

IntVectorProperty.name: AdaptationLevel
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: The number of times the high-order cells are refined. The default comes from the meta-file.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: AdaptationTolerance
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: The refinement tolerance. A negative value refines uniformly up to the adaptation level; a non-negative value is only used with one array. The default comes from the meta-file.

WriterProxy.name: GmshWriter
WriterProxy.Documentation: Write meshes with their data in a Gmsh file. Write temporal dataset into a single file containing all the timesteps.

InputProperty.name: Input
InputProperty.Documentation: This property specifies the elementary entity input to the writer.
This property specifies the physical group input to the writer.

StringVectorProperty.label: EntityArray
StringVectorProperty.name: SelectEntityArray
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: This property contains the name of the scalar array to use to determine the elementary entities of the array (entity tag at each cell).

StringVectorProperty.label: PhysicalGroupArray
StringVectorProperty.name: SelectPhysicalGroupArray
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: This property contains the name of the scalar array to use to determine the physical groups of the array (group tag at each cell).

IntVectorProperty.name: WriteGmshSpecificArray
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Specify if we write data arrays starting by "gmsh" (usually created by the Gmsh reader).

IntVectorProperty.name: WriteAllTimeSteps
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Specify if all timesteps have to be saved for temporal data.

StringVectorProperty.name: FileName
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: The name of the file to be written.

PSWriterProxy.name: PGmshWriter
PSWriterProxy.Documentation: Write meshes with their data in a Gmsh file. Write temporal dataset into a single file containing all the timesteps.

StringVectorProperty.name: FileName
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: The name of the file to be written.
